clarityKnownIssue.proposedWording: items whose topic list is nonempty and in which every lower-cased topic is a title token
clarityKnownIssue.reconsiderationTrigger: Flag if Sonnet also misses this exact clause; coordinator will reconsider task attribution.

decision: Apply the standing coordinator grammar adjudication to the identical failed clauses and observations in MAI repeat 3; retain its split panel and failed 14/16 result without rerun.
evidence: spec-misread: the candidate uses topics.some; the requirement explicitly says every lower-cased topic.
The nonempty condition and universal condition both apply to the item's topic list; a topic has no topics of its own.
Only the two topicsFromTitle count checks fail; other audit values and all blind/scoring checks pass.
Observed county/legislature counts are 7/5 versus 4/3; the second corpus's legislature count is 4 versus 2.
publicationScope: Sanitized attribution and immutable hashes; no raw messages, account data or credential state.
requirementQuote: topicsFromTitle counts items with at least one topic whose every lower-cased topic is a token of the title
